package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"github.com/vivym/vela/internal/financereconciliation"
)

func main() {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, os.Getenv("VELA_FINANCE_RECONCILIATION_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	service, err := financereconciliation.NewService(ctx, pool)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	limit := int64(100001)
	result, err := service.Apply(ctx, financereconciliation.Request{
		IdempotencyKey:           "n-minus-one-non-content-expiry-finance",
		SourceSequence:           1,
		OrganizationID:           uuid.MustParse(os.Getenv("VELA_ORGANIZATION_ID")),
		Kind:                     financereconciliation.KindContractCreditLimitChanged,
		Currency:                 "CNY",
		ContractCreditLimitMinor: &limit,
		ExternalReference:        "n-minus-one/non-content-expiry/finance",
		EffectiveAt:              time.Date(2026, 8, 27, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	})
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(struct {
		RecordID uuid.UUID `json:"record_id"`
		PostedAt time.Time `json:"posted_at"`
	}{RecordID: result.RecordID, PostedAt: result.PostedAt}); err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
}

func fatal(err error) {
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
	os.Exit(1)
}
